questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] A barometer is used to measure:
A. Atmospheric pressure
B. Humidity
C. Wind speed
Answer: A. Changes in atmospheric pressure can indicate weather changes; falling pressure typically indicates rainy or stormy weather, while rising pressure indicates fair weather.
questions.de: Was misst ein Barometer, dessen fallende Werte in der Regel regnerisches oder stürmisches Wetter ankündigen?
questions.en: What does a barometer measure, whose falling readings typically herald rainy or stormy weather?

timeline.labelEn: Evangelista Torricelli is credited with inventing the mercury barometer
timeline.labelDe: Evangelista Torricelli wird die Erfindung des Quecksilberbarometers zugeschrieben

questions.notes: Card confirmed. Middleton argues 1644 is the more likely year for Torricelli's invention.

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] How do swordfish use their long, flat bills for hunting?
A. To detect prey
B. To spear prey
C. To slash at prey
Answer: C. Swordfish use their long, flat bills to slash through schools of fish, slowing them just enough so that they can capture fast-moving prey effectively.
questions.de: Was machen Schwertfische mit ihrem langen, flachen Schwert höchstwahrscheinlich mit ihrer Beute, statt sie aufzuspießen?
questions.en: Rather than skewering it, what do swordfish most likely do to their prey with their long, flat bills?

timeline.labelEn: Carl Linnaeus scientifically describes the swordfish (Xiphias gladius)
timeline.labelDe: Carl von Linné beschreibt den Schwertfisch (Xiphias gladius) wissenschaftlich

questions.notes: Card confirmed: Wikipedia says the image of the swordfish skewering prey rests on little evidence; it most likely slashes at prey to inflict weakening injuries. Accept 'slash/strike at it to injure it'.
